html: Budget for the descaling routine, not just capsules: Nespresso's US VertuoPlus help recommends descaling every three months or 300 capsules, whichever comes first. It also says the manual's half-red/half-green alert can look yellow. If a used machine shows an ambiguous light, identify the exact model and follow its maintenance guide before assuming a hardware fault. This is manufacturer guidance, not a measured service interval for every water supply. Checked October 22, 2026. [source]
note: Nespresso US VertuoPlus FAQ explains the alert colour and recommends three months or 300 capsules.

html: Separate milk-path and coffee-path cleaning: the BES880 US manual directs owners to wipe the steam wand after texturing and use Settings > Steam wand cleaning when its holes obstruct flow. For a blocked basket, it describes the cleaning-tool pin and, if needed, an approximately 20-minute cleaning-tablet soak followed by a thorough rinse. A screen prompt does not clean the portafilter for you. These steps help a secondhand buyer distinguish ordinary residue from a claimed steam or extraction fault. Checked October 22, 2026. [source]
note: BES880 US manual separates steam-wand cleaning from basket and portafilter cleaning.

html: Two black coffees are easier than two milk drinks: Philips' exact EP3241/54 specification lists Double Cup but explicitly says Milk Double Cup: No. The 3200 can run milk recipes one after another; it is not a one-touch two-latte service. For a household that routinely makes paired cappuccinos, include the second carafe cycle and rinse in the buying decision, rather than treating the general two-serving specification as a milk feature. This is a published capability, not Coffeedant timing data. Checked October 22, 2026. [source]
note: EP3241/54 US specification distinguishes Double Cup from Milk Double Cup: No.

html: Purge before trusting an assisted dose: Breville's BES876 US manual recommends clearing retained grounds from the burrs or chute before the first coffee of the day. Holding Dose runs the purge until release; in Auto mode, discard that dose and reseat the portafilter to return to standby. The assisted tamp and top-up feedback cannot tell whether old grounds were in the path. Buyers alternating beans should allow a little purge waste in the routine. Checked October 22, 2026. [source]
note: BES876 US manual describes grinder purge and the Auto-mode reset after discarding purged grounds.

html: Plan a full BES920 descale session: Breville's US guide asks owners to let the machine cool for at least an hour and allow roughly 1.5 hours for the complete procedure. It includes boiler emptying and two fresh-water flush stages, with caution around hot water and the front access valves. A quick tablet backflush is a different coffee-oil task. For a used machine with an outstanding descale alert, ask about the water history and follow the exact BES920 revision's instructions rather than starting a hurried partial cycle. Checked October 22, 2026. [source]
note: BES920 US manual specifies cool-down, approximate full-cycle time, boiler draining and repeat flushing.

html: Ask about the US service route: Baratza offers support-guided paid mail-in repair when an at-home fix is unsuitable; walk-ins are unavailable. Parts availability varies by model. Keep the ESP Pro's ZCG595 identity and receipt for a compatible-parts inquiry; a future repair quote is not guaranteed. Checked October 22, 2026. [source]
note: Baratza US repair explainer distinguishes at-home help, paid mail-in service, no walk-ins and model-dependent parts availability.
